      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game collects personal data and shares it with third parties.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "With more and more full games finding their way to mobile, I picked up a dedicated “stretch” controller for us with my iPhone. I was so excited when I saw the full version of Stardew, one of my favorite games of all time, was available here. Naturally I bought it immediately and jumped in.\n\nAt first things seemed fine, but near the end of the first day I realized I was missing one of my starter tools. I had no storage yet, and it wouldn’t let me drop them, so I couldn’t figure out what happened. About 3 minutes later, I hit the X-button (Square on PlayStation controllers) and saw it happen live - the highlighted item vanished. It wasn’t on the ground, it wasn’t in storage, it was permanently deleted. I replicated it with my entire inventory before restarting the game / day, and replicated it some more.\n\nIt appears this bug has gone back years, with many posts requesting fixes or sub  feature requests that lay dormant. Yes I could play hoping I don’t press it by mistake, or rebind it to another button to avoid it entirely, but that’s a band-aid at best, not a real solution.\n\nMaybe it is Apple’s fault, a long running iOS bug or something, but I don’t think so. I have a dozen other games that all utilize the X button without issue and generally play perfectly with a controller.  \n\nMy plan is to check back in on Stardew Mobile every few months in hopes a patch finally comes. I know controller mobile players are still a minority, but it’s a percentage of the base that grows more and more every year and I will change my review to 5 stars at that time."
